name: Toronto insulin treatment
description: In 1922 Leonard Thompson received an early clinically effective insulin treatment at Toronto General Hospital.

date.label: 23 January 1922
date.basis: Date refers to the scoped documented case, not global origin.

events.statement: In 1922 Leonard Thompson received an early clinically effective insulin treatment at Toronto General Hospital.

evidence.supports: The review dates a clinically successful early treatment of Leonard Thompson at Toronto General Hospital to 23 January 1922, after a less effective attempt earlier that month. It credits a larger research team and earlier work; one case is not broad access.
The archival exhibit dates the second treatment to 23 January, identifies Collip’s preparation, and says the treatments were administered under chief clinician W. R. Campbell’s direction.

events.caveats: The early work built on prior research and involved multiple contributors. One patient’s experience does not establish population-level access or a cure.
